name: Topical Study
description: A question or topic followed through the whole of Scripture.

sections.guidance: The question you are asking, stated as clearly as you can.

sections.title: Main Themes
sections.guidance: The main lines of teaching that emerge.

sections.title: Conclusions

sections.title: Application

sections.guidance: Where and how the topic arises across the Bible.

sections.title: Difficult Passages

sections.title: Theology
sections.guidance: How the passages fit together into coherent teaching.
